authority.title: Authority
authority.default: Explanation only; backend metrics and constraint verdicts remain authoritative

N_max.title: N Max
N_max.description: Frontend maximum stages (Hybrid Calculator B13); example 15.

U_stage_max_V.title: U Stage Max V
U_stage_max_V.description: Frontend maximum charging voltage per stage in V (B14); example 200000.

C_stage_F.title: C Stage F
C_stage_F.description: Frontend stage capacitance in F (B15); example 3e-6.

stage_energy_max_J.title: Stage Energy Max J
stage_energy_max_J.description: Frontend energy limit per stage in J; omitted/null uses 2500 J fallback.

EquipmentInputs.title: EquipmentInputs
EquipmentInputs.description: Editable equipment fields; omitted/null values request the profile fallback.

max_proposals.title: Max Proposals
max_proposals.description: Omitted API field uses POWERNEXT_CALIBRATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS; 24 is the fallback.

max_forward_evaluations.title: Max Forward Evaluations
max_forward_evaluations.description: Omitted API field uses POWERNEXT_CALIBRATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS; 24 is the fallback.

max_ml_evaluations.title: Max Ml Evaluations
max_ml_evaluations.description: Omitted API field uses POWERNEXT_CALIBRATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS; 24 is the fallback.

repeat_window.title: Repeat Window
repeat_window.description: Legacy compatibility field; repetition does not stop the search.

archive_stagnation_window.title: Archive Stagnation Window
archive_stagnation_window.description: Legacy compatibility field; stagnation does not stop the search.

wall_time_seconds.title: Wall Time Seconds
wall_time_seconds.description: Omitted API field uses POWERNEXT_CALIBRATION_WALL_TIME_SECONDS; 600 is the fallback.
